patterns.note: Alternating full-width image and text blocks are used for feature sections, creating a balanced and editorial content flow.
A single elegant sans-serif font is used consistently across all text elements, with clear size and weight variations establishing a refined typographic hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of predominantly white backgrounds and dark text is employed, allowing rich, full-bleed photography to be the primary visual focus.
Main content sections animate into view with a subtle upward slide and fade effect as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
An initial promotional modal overlay disappears as the user scrolls down the page, revealing the hero content.
Each major content section is structured as a full-width block, pairing a large, high-quality photograph with a concise text description, with the image and text positions alternating left and right.

technique_notes: An initial full-screen promotional modal appears on page load and dismisses automatically or on user scroll. As the user scrolls down, main content sections are revealed with a subtle upward slide and fade animation as they enter the viewport.
A transparent header bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, maintaining its appearance without shrinking or changing background, providing persistent navigation.

Major content sections are presented as full-width blocks, each featuring a large, high-quality photograph paired with a text description, with the image and text positions alternating left and right across subsequent sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: A balanced scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger and bolder than body text, while sub-headings are often smaller and uppercase.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and clean, with ample whitespace around content blocks, creating an airy feel without being sparse.

standout: The site's elegant simplicity is its most distinctive feature, placing a strong emphasis on high-quality, full-bleed photography to convey a luxurious and sophisticated atmosphere. The design is understated, allowing the visual appeal of the food and ambiance to dominate, supported by clean typography and subtle scroll animations.
